source: Current imported case records, landing copy, civic source READMEs and localized project drawers
limitations: HTTP success verifies response availability, not factual correctness or client-side rendering.
GitHub paths are checked against exact SHA trees; a truncated tree never establishes absence.
Blocked, unavailable and bounded-out requests remain unverified, not passing.
Internal fragments require the separate rendered DOM regression suite.
HTTP checks cancel bodies after headers; no large datasets or remote media are downloaded.
